name: business-card-maker
description: Make business cards for the whole team from one spreadsheet. Pick the staff list and your logo, set the company name and website, and get a print-shop PDF (one page per side, with bleed, crop marks and trim boxes) plus an A4 sheet for printing in the office. Each card can carry a QR code that saves the person straight into a phone's contacts, and every person also gets a .vcf contact file. Three front designs, 90×54, 85×55 or US sizes, Chinese and English side by side. Runs locally; no design service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 一张员工表就能给全公司批量做名片。选上员工名单和公司 logo，填好公司名和网址，就能得到给印刷厂的 PDF（每面一页，带出血、裁切线和成品框）和办公室自己打印用的 A4 拼版。名片上可以印二维码，手机一扫就存进通讯录；每个人还会单独导出一份 .vcf 电子名片。三种正面版式，90×54、85×55 或美式尺寸，中英双语。在本地运行，不用设计服务，无需 API 密钥。
